name: Modules.CoreMotion.Magnetometer
summary: Allows Titanium client applications to access CoreMotion's Magnetometer APIs.

methods.name: getMagnetometerData
methods.summary: Returns the latest sample of magnetometer data.
methods.description:
An app that is receiving magnetometer data after calling 
[Modules.CoreMotion.Magnetometer.startMagnetometerUpdates](api:Modules.CoreMotion.Magnetometer#startMagnetometerUpdates) with no callback, needs to periodically
check the value returned by this method and process the magnetometer data.

methods.name: isMagnetometerActive
methods.summary: Returns a Boolean indicating whether magnetometer updates are currently happening.
methods.description:
Indicates whether [Modules.CoreMotion.Magnetometer.startMagnetometerUpdates](api:Modules.CoreMotion.Magnetometer#startMagnetometerUpdates) has been called since 
<Modules.CoreMotion.stopMagnetometerUpdates>.

methods.name: isMagnetometerAvailable
methods.summary: Returns a Boolean indicating whether a magnetometer is available on the device.

methods.name: setMagnetometerUpdateInterval
methods.summary: The interval in milliseconds, for providing magnetometer updates to the callback.

methods.name: startMagnetometerUpdates
methods.description:
If a callback is passed to this method, it will be called whenever there is an update.
The frequency of these updates can be controlled using the 
[Modules.CoreMotion.Magnetometer.setMagnetometerUpdateInterval](api:Modules.CoreMotion.Magnetometer#setMagnetometerUpdateInterval) method. If no callback is passed, 
the magnetometer data can be accessed using the [Modules.CoreMotion.Magnetometer.getMagnetometerData](api:Modules.CoreMotion.Magnetometer#getMagnetometerData) 
method. You must call [Modules.CoreMotion.Magnetometer.stopMagnetometerUpdates](api:Modules.CoreMotion.Magnetometer#stopMagnetometerUpdates) when you no 
longer want your app to process magnetometer updates.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.summary: The method to be called when there is an update.

inlined.name: CoreMotionMagnetometerDataWithSuccess
inlined.summary: Dictionary passed to the callback of the [Magnetometer.startMagnetometerUpdates()](api:Modules.CoreMotion.Magnetometer#startMagnetometerUpdates) method.

properties.name: code
properties.summary: An error code describing the error if there was one.

properties.name: error
properties.summary: An error message describing the error if there was one.

properties.name: success
properties.summary: A Boolean indicating if the operation was successful or not.
